evals.prompt: Find the right README insertion point for a new Zed LSP task section and identify nearby docs that must stay in sync. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: A docs sync plan with a primary insertion point, must-update references, maybe-update references, and verification notes.
assertions: Output identifies a primary insertion point
Output separates must-update from maybe-update references
Output stays read-only and does not draft unrelated edits

evals.prompt: We changed a developer command in justfile. Plan which docs should be updated without duplicating policy text.
evals.expected_output: A concise plan that distinguishes canonical human docs from agent-only rules and proposes link/path verification.
assertions: Output checks human-facing docs separately from agent rules
Output warns against duplicating long policy text
